rows.text:
Will Bite, Do Not Approach!

This is my pet robot Sevy. It used to do everything I say, but now it's sick, and it might bite people!
I heard Boss Svarog can fix robots, so I'm leaving Sevy here.
Boss Svarog, please please save my Sevy!
When Sevy is all better again, it will come home on its own. It knows the way home!

*This is a note on a broken robot with no name attached. So, this robot could bite? Unfortunately, it can't anymore.*
